name: Champions Tactics Reforged
description:
Inspired from classic strategy board games and modern turn-based RPGs, Champions Tactics™ Reforged is a game where strategy, creativity, and dark fantasy unite in a captivating multiplayer tactical experience.

In the dark world of Grimoria, you rise as a young lord entrusted with leading a team of mythical Champions crafted by a mysterious Alchemist using forbidden magic. Champions are magical playable figurines and each one of them is a living relic, a testament to the legendary Champions who once shaped Grimoria’s fate.

Engage in thrilling turn-based tactical battles against other players where the outcome relies on tactics, mind games, and Champions' abilities. Diversity reigns supreme as you assemble your team with a vast array of Champions, each a unique masterpiece with its own distinctive abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

Will you choose The Grim Rogue, The Ardent Diviner or The Savage Oracle? The choice is yours!

BECOME A WORLDWIDE LEGEND

Test your tactical prowess in intense online PvP battles, rise through the ranks, and earn epic rewards.

INVOKE CHAMPION

Master the power of the Bloodstone to invoke powerful champions with unique skills & abilities.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM 

Collect thousands of unique powerful champions to outmatch any opponent's lineup.

TACTICAL PLAY TO WIN

Victory comes from skill, not chance. Master the ever-changing meta, pick the best Champions to counter your opponent's lineup and use their abilities wisely to dominate!

requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 3,9 GHz, AMD Ryzen 3 1200 3,2 GHz
Memory: 8 MB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 Go) or AMD RX 5500 XT (4 Go)
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 5 GB available space
requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bits)
Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 2,8 GHz, AMD Ryzen 5 2600 3,4 GHz
Memory: 8 MB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6 Go) or AMD RX 5500 XT (8 Go)
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 5 GB available space
